name: Sound Wizard (HTML)
description: An audio analyser for the phone, fast enough to keep up with real sound. A sound level meter with A, C and flat weighting; a spectrogram with FFT sizes up to 32768 and seven colour maps; a triggered oscilloscope; a tuner for guitar, bass, ukulele and strings that reads to a tenth of a cent, with a ten-second pitch trace; and tone analysis that names the base note, the chord and the key and shows the harmonics. It all runs in a background worker, on the device: nothing is recorded or sent.
note: Made for the phone (iPhone and Android): tap to listen; the microphone needs the https address.
